```python
import json, pandas as pd
with open("gross_savings_raw.json") as f:
    raw = json.load(f)
meta, data = raw
rows = []
for item in data:
    # item has keys: country, countryiso3code, date, value
    if item.get('country') and item['country'].get('value'):
        rows.append({
            'country': item['country']['value'],
            'iso3': item['countryiso3code'],
            'year': int(item['date']),
            'value': item['value']
        })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df = df[df['year'].between(2001, 2010)]
pivot = df.pivot_table(index=['country','iso3'], columns='year', values='value')
pivot = pivot.reset_index()
pivot.to_csv('gross_savings_2001_2010_pivot.csv', index=False)
print(pivot.shape)
print(pivot.head(3))
```
